title: Every morning, something on the towpath says good morning in my voice
description:
I live on a narrowboat on a quiet canal with my old dog, Moss. For twelve years I said the same two words at the hatch every morning. This summer I stopped.

Now, at dawn in the autumn fog, something lying on the towpath says them for me. It's one mooring ring nearer each morning, and Moss keeps climbing up to meet it.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What's something you used to say every single day, then stopped? Who would notice first?
